complete_update_calibration.scope: Complete-update normalized hand output gradient; sum squared disjoint microbatch norms, not model parameter gradients
complete_update_calibration.limitation: A fixed coefficient calibrated on one train update; no claim that every later update obeys this ratio

Final coefficient uses one additional complete train-only update; no validation/test tuning; original receipts preserved.
All future context is loss-only; two configurations per complete update; stratified mean is not population-unbiased.
